Dear   Student,* Congratulations on being shortlisted for the Internship
Program!*

🎓*TEACHNOOK* in collaboration with *Wissenaire(IIT Bhubaneswar)* brings
you a unique *2-month Internship + Training program.*

*👇Here is an outline of the program's structure.👇*

 📚*Training program*:- Provides a comprehensive and immersive learning
experience by industry professionals having *10+ years of work ex* with
over *60+ hours* of content spread across 25-30 modules. Prerequisite
classes ensure students have the foundational knowledge required to make
them industry ready.

⚙️*Industrial Internship*:- Provides practical experience with *10+ live
projects* alongside the training program. Projects challenge students to
apply learned skills in real-world situations. The *CAPSTONE* project,
integrated into the final week of the internship, requires students to use
all learned skills and knowledge.
*Top Preferred Courses: *
✅

*Artificial Intelligence.✅ Data Science.✅ Machine Learning.✅ Cloud
Computing.*
*✅ Cyber Security.*
*✅ Full Stack Web Development.*
*✅ Management.*
⚙️ *Interested students fill out the google form, if you get shortlisted
you will get a call from our HR Team:*
*👉  *https://forms.gle/VCWQ3vaKj1Vqmnp98

🎉

* By joining our program, you'll receive:🟡 Program completion certificate
from Teachnook in collaboration with IIT-B (Wissenaire)🟡 Co-branded
Internship Certificate from MNC's (i.e IBM & MICROSOFT)🟡Mock interviews
